name: preflow/notify
description: Preflow notify — send email, SMS and other messages through pluggable transports

suggest.preflow/view: Renders composed mails with a template (TemplateMailLayout, @notify/mail/layout.twig); without it they use the plain PHP layout
suggest.psr/log: Logs deferred (sendLater) failures that have no onFailure callback
suggest.symfony/mailer: Enables the symfony-mailer transport (SMTP and all Symfony mailer bridges)
suggest.symfony/notifier: Enables the symfony-notifier-sms transport (Twilio, Vonage and other Symfony SMS bridges)
